title: Longest Well-Performing Interval
summary: Given a list of daily work hours, identify the longest interval where the number of tiring days (hours > 8) exceeds the non-tiring days.
statement: Given a list of daily work hours, identify the longest interval where the number of tiring days (hours > 8) exceeds the non-tiring days. A tiring day is defined as having more than 8 hours worked.
constraints: A day is tiring when hours>8.
Return longest interval with more tiring than non-tiring days.
hints: Map tiring days to +1 and others to -1; a valid interval has positive sum.
Store the first index of each prefix score.
Positive total from start gives i+1; otherwise score-1 locates an earlier prefix producing +1 or more.
Earliest occurrences maximize length, and integer steps guarantee crossing score-1.
editorial: Earliest occurrences maximize length, and integer steps guarantee crossing score-1.

tests.explanation: The first three days score +1 overall, giving length three.
